items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I’m going out with Trade Winds, and some marvelous players that I’m excited about, and Fred Tillis on saxophone

ctx.x: What’s in the near future for you? I know you mentioned you’re going to be going to Europe with a group from U Mass.

Yes I’m going out with Trade Winds, and some marvelous players that I’m excited about, and Fred Tillis on saxophone, and a marvelous upcoming bass player that I have been playing with, Genevieve Rose, who is looking forward to that, and I’m doing a cruise to Hawaii with the Benny Goodman big band, it’s a jazz cruise, and there’ll be several other groups on there and we’ll trade off and I’m excited about that. It’s a challenge to sit in Mr. Krupa’s chair. I’m boning up for it.
